title: PM7 build project, work and Pip contracts
description: Owner contracts CS-105/CS-106, SIR-054, SSYS-056 and static GUI presentation F3-447/F3-535/ACD-506. Static schema only; no Event Authority or native implementation admission. Current owner/permission/identity comparison is semantic validation before dispatch. PresentationPolicy is not part of the command/action request union.

work_id.description: Optional exact process/scheduled row for dock Review/Show; owner must bind to the signed Project/thread and expected generation. No title fallback.

PipPartsSettingValue.description: S2: canonical Project Settings writes use registry labels. Stable part IDs remain registry/API identity; compatibility reads may map IDs to labels.

ActivityDetailViewState.description: G1 B, Jared 2026-10-30: session-only presentation state. Pin preserves the open full-size view across thread switches while its data follows the selected thread; no durable layout/Settings/runtime write.

system_status_settings_route_request.description: D11/G4: read-only System status owner-Settings reveal using the already admitted ui.settings.route.open action. No Settings write, service action, event or receipt.

reused_work_command_id.description: Existing owner command IDs reused by work-detail producers for reverse Touch coverage; no new command family or handler.

ReusedCatalogRequestIdentity.description: Identity-only fence from the existing UI catalog dispatch minimum. Additional fields belong to the catalog owner contract and are NOT validated or admitted here. No native payload, effect or terminal-success proof.

PresentationPolicy.description: Static G2/F3-1 owner policy descriptor, not a native request, runtime event, persisted value or GUI execution proof. Threshold and relative first-card anchor are approved by Jared 2026-10-30. Final GUI 70b30f482f aligns the first card to the theme selector wrapper bottom plus menu gap, allowing a negative drop; open-inbox placement remains the separately attributed lead exception.
